topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range introduces scan losses, beam squint, and increased side lobe levels, impacting link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users. Broadside beams maintain stable performance, while scanned beams suffer from interference and reduced signal quality, affecting network capacity and reliability.
reference_context: Scan range and beam steering affect antenna performance, with broadside beams showing stable gain and scanned beams experiencing scan losses and beam squint.
